en.t: He stared fixedly at the corpse.

units.source_text: 为了写完一个短篇——一个以王朝时代为背景的一个短篇，他必须要这么做。

en.t: To finish writing a short story, one set in the age of the court, he had to do this.

units.source_text: 可，尸臭像腐烂了的杏子一样无比难闻。

en.t: But the stench of the corpse was unbearably foul, like rotting apricots.

units.source_text: 他的朋友蹙起眉头，安静的操作着解剖刀。

en.t: His friend furrowed his brow and quietly handled the dissecting knife.
